The executor session su-7cca71f6 was launched by the implementer (su-0dd6b9aa) at 04:29Z through capability:launch-agent with a brief to adopt the agent name bug-triage and work its assigned items. The classification of run 1344 itself came from that session reacting to the dispatch with no further prompt, but the executor process is not yet started by the platform; standing up the executor is a manual step today.

The executor must be connected to a build that serves ticket:file. An executor connected to :3070 (green main d740fc3802) gets unknown_tool and blocks the item (measured on BD009, run 1343); tracked as EI-25837118762007088.

Each bug-triage plan run also mints an acceptance-carry work-item that lands on the executor (WI-6554700010009765 for this run); tracked as WI-6554700010009790. It does not affect ingress, classification or filing.
The window end (05:00Z) was later than the measurement time; the in-app-path-silent check covers only rows present when the instrument ran.
The Asana task identity comes from the trigger run's recorded ticket filing; the instrument does not query Asana's API.
This drill posted in the chosen channel, so it does not exercise the non-chosen-channel case; that case is guarded by the ticket.ts channel check and its integration test.
